userStories.title: Add lib/changelog_generator.py and .cliff.toml for CHANGELOG generation
userStories.description: Create lib/changelog_generator.py with generate_changelog(start_sha, end_sha, prd_path, iteration_num) that invokes git-cliff via subprocess with a .cliff.toml config. The .cliff.toml parses US-NNNN story IDs from conventional commits and groups output into feat/fix/docs sections.
acceptanceCriteria: uv run pytest tests/test_changelog_generator.py::test_generate_changelog_us_pattern -v passes; test verifies returned string contains US-NNNN entry grouped under [feat] or [fix]
git-cliff --config .cliff.toml --version exits 0 and .cliff.toml parses conventional commit type prefixes (feat/fix/docs) with story ID capture group
generate_changelog() raises ValueError if start_sha or end_sha is empty string; returns non-empty string on valid git range
technicalNotes: File to edit: lib/changelog_generator.py (generate_changelog function) — new file; use subprocess.run(['git-cliff', '--config', '.cliff.toml', f'{start_sha}..{end_sha}'], capture_output=True)
File to edit: .cliff.toml (root config) — new file; set [git] section with conventional_commits=true, commit_parsers matching '^(feat|fix|docs)\(US-\d+\)' pattern
File to edit: tests/test_changelog_generator.py (test_generate_changelog_us_pattern) — new file; mock subprocess.run to return sample git-cliff output containing US-0001
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_changelog_generator.py -v

userStories.title: Phase G: Invoke changelog_generator and commit CHANGELOG.md after iteration
userStories.description: Extend lib/phases/phase_g.sh to call lib/changelog_generator.py after all iteration stories are committed, write the result to CHANGELOG.md at repo root, and stage+commit the file. Phase G must abort with a non-zero exit if CHANGELOG.md is empty after generation.
acceptanceCriteria: After phase_g.sh runs, CHANGELOG.md exists at repo root and contains at least one entry; phase exits non-zero if the file is missing or empty
CHANGELOG.md is added and committed in git with message 'chore: update CHANGELOG for iteration N'; verify with git log --oneline -1 showing that message
technicalNotes: File to edit: lib/phases/phase_g.sh (changelog block after story commit loop) — call `uv run python lib/changelog_generator.py --start "$ITER_START_SHA" --end HEAD --prd prd.json --iteration "$SPIRAL_ITERATION"` and redirect stdout to CHANGELOG.md
Add CLI entrypoint to lib/changelog_generator.py using argparse so phase_g.sh can invoke it directly
Test command: bash -c 'SPIRAL_ITERATION=1 bash lib/phases/phase_g.sh --dry-run 2>&1 | grep -q changelog && echo OK'
